2.source: relic set 319 (谧宁拾骨地 / Bone Collection's Serene Demesne), 2-piece: 「使装备者的生命上限提高#1[i]%。当装备者的生命上限大于等于#2[i]点时，使装备者及其忆灵的暴击伤害提高#3[i]%。」 param = [0.12, 5000, 0.28]
2.note: The wearer's half. ⚠ HEALTH is a BASE attribute, so the literal is absolute (`>= 5000`), unlike the ratio attributes where it would be a fraction -- the unit trap engine.md 4.6 records. 「生命上限提高#1[i]%」 is the `properties` stat (HPAddedRatio 0.12). ⚠ `BATTLE_START` + `permanent` is the standing approximation for the 'while' clause (the same one 301/302/304/306/307/309/310/311 use): the threshold is read once, when it is the least likely to have moved.

2.source: relic set 319 (谧宁拾骨地 / Bone Collection's Serene Demesne), 2-piece: 「使装备者及其忆灵的暴击伤害提高#3[i]%。」 param = [0.12, 5000, 0.28]
2.note: 「及其忆灵」, applied when the memosprite arrives -- the convention 124/319/320 established on 2026-09-28 (see set 124's file for why the two timings cannot be one rule: `target: "summon"` fails loudly when nothing is out, and at BATTLE_START there may be nothing out). ⚠ The threshold here is still the WEARER's Max HP: `self_attr` reads the rule's owner, and 「当装备者的生命上限大于等于 5000 点时」 is about her, not about the memosprite.
